video_title: NBA Draft Reactions! + Ant Next Superstar To Be Traded?!?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Why Anthony Edwards is not a realistic trade candidate
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards is not going anywhere. He is the face of the NBA.
quotes.quote: Anthony Edwards is not going anywhere. He is the face of the NBA. You have a guy who is 22 years old, who is charismatic, who is playing at an All-NBA level, and who is the reason people are tuning into Minnesota. You do not trade that. You do not even entertain the thought of moving a player who has that kind of gravitational pull on the league. The idea that he would be the next superstar to be traded is just noise. He is the foundation for the next decade of that franchise.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: The challenge of building around a young star like Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: The pressure is on the front office to maximize his window right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: The problem in Minnesota is not Anthony Edwards, it is the cap situation. They have so much money tied up in Karl-Anthony Towns and others that they cannot get him the secondary help he needs. The pressure is on the front office to maximize his window right now.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Exactly. If you do not surround him with the right pieces, you are wasting his prime. You cannot expect him to carry that load alone every single night in the Western Conference.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of the current NBA draft class depth and impact
quotes.excerpt: This draft class is being unfairly criticized for its lack of immediate impact.
quotes.quote: This draft class is being unfairly criticized for its lack of immediate impact. People want to see instant superstars, but the reality is that these guys need time to develop in a professional system. The front offices that are patient with these picks are going to be the ones that look smart in three years. It is not about who is the best player today, it is about who fits the long-term identity of your roster.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' future trade speculation and Minnesota's financial constraints
quotes.excerpt: If Minnesota cannot put the right pieces around Anthony Edwards, he is going to want out.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: If Minnesota cannot put the right pieces around Anthony Edwards, he is going to want out. You look at the second apron, you look at the financial situation they are in, it is going to be impossible to keep this roster together. If they do not win a championship soon, he is the next guy who is going to be looking for a way out.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I agree. When you have a talent like Ant, you have to maximize that window. If the front office fails to provide him with a legitimate supporting cast because of those salary cap restrictions, you are just wasting his prime. Players today do not wait around for organizations to figure it out.
